content.title: Applying for scholarships?
content.subtitle: The scholarship process needs as much care as your admission.

steps.title: Read the eligibility
steps.detail: Country, course, marks or background. Don't spend time on ones you don't fit.

steps.title: List deadlines separately
steps.detail: The scholarship deadline can differ from the admission one. Keep two separate lists.

steps.title: Keep documents ready
steps.detail: Transcripts, resume, recommendations, and sometimes income proof. Scan them in advance.

steps.title: Write the essay yourself
steps.detail: Your story, in your own words. A template essay looks the same everywhere.

steps.title: Apply widely
steps.detail: Small scholarships help too. Several together make a big difference.
steps.tip: Filter by country and level on Scholarship Finder.

caption:
Applying for scholarships? Don't miss these 5 steps 👇

1. Read the eligibility
2. List deadlines separately
3. Keep documents ready
4. Write the essay yourself
5. Apply widely
